contexts.text: God give thee of the dew of heaven () = from Divine truth... The dew of heaven = truth. AC 3600:2.
That dew = truth, is also evident from the Word elsewhere. Illustrated.
The dew of birth () = the Celestial of love.

In the genuine sense, dew = the truth of good which comes from a state of innocence and peace; for the morning, or dawn, when the dew descends, = these states; hence the manna came when the dew descended in the early morning... The dew in which and with which the manna descended = Divine truth in the supreme sense; and, in the relative sense, = spiritual truth with men. AC 3600.
As dew = the truth which is from good, or, what is the same, the Spiritual which is from the Celestial, in the Word spiritual truth is compared to dew. Illustrated.

Dew, here () = the multiplication of truth from good, and the fructification of good through truth; and as the dew is what every morning renders the field and the vineyard fruitful, good and truth itself are signified by corn and must.

There was a deposit of dew about the camp () = the truth of peace adjoining itself. Dew = the truth of peace... because it descends from heaven in the morning, and appears upon plants like fine rain, and also has stored up in it something sweet and delightful more than rain has, whereby the grass and standing corn are gladdened; and morning = a state of peace. Explained.

And the deposit of dew went up () = the insinuation of truth... Dew = the truth of peace. The depositing of this upon the manna = the insinuation of truth; for the truth of peace is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord in Heaven, which, as it is the inmost, insinuates itself into the truth which is beneath, and vivifies it, as the dew is wont to do the grass or standing corn on which it falls in the morning...
[155a]. There appeared a golden shower; it was the early morning dew descending in such abundance...
The rain with the dew, in which was the manna = the influx of Divine truth in which was this delight.
The dew from Jehovah () = spiritual truth.
The marriage of good and truth, and their fructification and multiplication, are signified by the dew of Hermon which descended upon the mountains of Zion ().
The dew of Hermon = Divine truth.
His heavens shall drop dew () = influx from Heaven.
Dew () = spiritual things communicating.
Dew = influx thence.
A cloud of dew () = truth from good fructifying.
To be to him as the dew () = his spiritual coming forth and rebirth.
The dew () = good; and as this is also signified by word, it is said, My word shall distil as the dew.
The heavens shall give dew () = these things by virtue of influx from the Lord.
Then from the cloud there dropped as it were dew, which was scattered about and condensed into manna... This represented the heavenly affections of the thoughts in their speech.
As the dew of the dawn falling from heaven into the earth...
